description: Exact official MiniMax H3 Image BF16 checkpoint for text-to-image generation and ordered-reference image editing with SGLang Diffusion. It keeps the root SGLang layout (transformer, text encoder, VAE, tokenizer, processor, scheduler and PDD heads) and leaves out the duplicate Diffusers-format transformer and VAE trees, showcase assets and examples.
